definition: This step can be taken now. It says nothing of whether the step before it was judged: a plan not yet evaluated can be sent to the drawings, and the drawings will say so.
basis: docs/workbench.md, the shell since Phase 17, the table of the words a station of the house's journey carries, which says of "ready" that "this step can be taken now"; and journey/journey.js, which marks the drawings and the export ready on a plan the bench has not yet evaluated.
